scope: Provenance and license-boundary audit for the formal-source commit referenced by Kokuno Navier-Stokes metadata; no Kokuno proof/checker code or substantial prose is copied.

kokuno_source.formal_source_recorded_scope: Static source/import and declaration comparison; not kernel verification.
kokuno_source.formal_source_recorded_import_compilatio: in progress; endpoint, fresh replay and comparator not completed

formal_repo_material.rule: Only material whose provenance is actually in openai/NavierStokesAndEuler at the pinned commit may rely on that repository's Apache-2.0 grant; preserve attribution/license obligations when reused.

kokuno_workbench_and_bundle_material.rule: Do not infer that the formal repository's Apache-2.0 license covers Kokuno-authored reader, proof-body, checker, review, or bundle material. For Kokuno material, retain DOI/URL/path/hash/provenance and independently reimplement facts/formulas unless a separate license grant is verified.

rights_boundary.cross_repo_rule: A citation or attribution relationship between repositories is provenance evidence, not a license transitivity rule.

SOURCE_IMPORT_MAP_refinement: Formal-source identifiers and declarations may be mapped as separately licensed provenance.
Kokuno component hashes, paths, counts, formulas/facts remain metadata/reference inputs unless independently reimplemented or separately licensed.
No component status is upgraded by the existence of the formal-source repository.
